summary: An integrated large-event C-UAS and security screening solution for stadium entrances, arenas, exhibition centers, fan zones, media areas, logistics gates, VIP routes, and surrounding public spaces. It combines low-altitude detection, identification, location, tracking, warning linkage, high-throughput entrance screening, baggage and materials inspection, command-center linkage, and traceable event records.

parameters.operation_upgrade_title: How Integrated Monitoring and Screening Support Large Events
parameters.solution_modules_intro: The solution follows the airport-security page structure but adapts it to temporary event operations, combining low-altitude awareness, entrance screening, baggage inspection, command-center coordination, and post-event review.
industry_pain_points: Large sports events concentrate spectators, athletes, staff, media teams, vendors, logistics vehicles, VIP routes, and temporary structures into a short operating window with little tolerance for delay.
Venue operators must coordinate low-altitude awareness, entrance screening, baggage checks, staff access, and emergency communication while keeping visitor movement smooth.

Temporary deployments need airport-style checkpoint discipline: equipment that can be installed quickly, operated consistently, logged clearly, and removed after the event without losing review records.
uav_industry_upgrade: C-UAS workflows help event command teams maintain awareness around stadium roofs, fan zones, broadcast areas, parking zones, and surrounding public spaces.
Walk-through, handheld, X-ray, and trace-detection screening equipment supports high-throughput checks for spectators, staff, media teams, and delivered materials.
A shared command process connects low-altitude warnings, checkpoint exceptions, bag-inspection results, operator notes, and handling status for live coordination and post-event review.

solution_modules.name: Temporary Airspace Awareness
solution_modules.description: Monitor low-altitude activity around venues, fan zones, broadcast areas, team routes, parking areas, and logistics yards during event windows.

solution_modules.name: High-Throughput Entrance Screening
solution_modules.description: Use handheld metal detectors, phone-detection gates where required, and checkpoint procedures to keep spectator, staff, and media access organized.

solution_modules.name: Baggage and Materials Inspection
solution_modules.description: Deploy X-ray baggage scanning and trace inspection for bags, parcels, broadcast equipment, vendor materials, and service deliveries.

solution_modules.name: Command Center and Event Review
solution_modules.description: Connect alerts, screening exceptions, operator notes, timestamps, and handling status to the event command center for live coordination and review reports.

parameters.typical_outputs: Venue low-altitude warnings, checkpoint exception records, baggage inspection logs, command-center event timelines, and post-event review materials

detail_html:
Industry Pain Points

  • Large sports events concentrate spectators, athletes, staff, media teams, vendors, logistics vehicles, VIP routes, and temporary structures into a short operating window with little tolerance for delay.
  • Venue operators must coordinate low-altitude awareness, entrance screening, baggage checks, staff access, and emergency communication while keeping visitor movement smooth.
  • Temporary deployments need airport-style checkpoint discipline: equipment that can be installed quickly, operated consistently, logged clearly, and removed after the event without losing review records.

Security Operation Upgrade

  • C-UAS workflows help event command teams maintain awareness around stadium roofs, fan zones, broadcast areas, parking zones, and surrounding public spaces.
  • Walk-through, handheld, X-ray, and trace-detection screening equipment supports high-throughput checks for spectators, staff, media teams, and delivered materials.
  • A shared command process connects low-altitude warnings, checkpoint exceptions, bag-inspection results, operator notes, and handling status for live coordination and post-event review.

Solution Modules

  • Temporary Airspace Awareness: Monitor low-altitude activity around venues, fan zones, broadcast areas, team routes, parking areas, and logistics yards during event windows.
  • High-Throughput Entrance Screening: Use handheld metal detectors, phone-detection gates where required, and checkpoint procedures to keep spectator, staff, and media access organized.
  • Baggage and Materials Inspection: Deploy X-ray baggage scanning and trace inspection for bags, parcels, broadcast equipment, vendor materials, and service deliveries.
  • Command Center and Event Review: Connect alerts, screening exceptions, operator notes, timestamps, and handling status to the event command center for live coordination and review reports.

summary_ru: Защита мероприятий и выставок с числом участников более 10 000 человек. Решение проблем высокой плотности людей, управления потоками и слепых зон в безопасности. Объединяет предупреждение о БПЛА с интеллектуальными терминалами досмотра для круглосуточного мониторинга и перехвата опасных грузов.
key_application_ru: Обеспечение безопасности спортивных и крупных выставочных мероприятий
key_parameter_1_ru: Высокопроизводительная проверка: Эффективный досмотр и быстрый перехват запрещенных предметов при массовом скоплении людей
key_parameter_2_ru: Мониторинг без слепых зон: Сочетание всенаправленного обнаружения и видеонаблюдения для предотвращения рисков от нелегальных БПЛА

parameters_ru.Мобильность оборудования: Переносные модули или мобильное развертывание на авто
parameters_ru.Зона мониторинга: 360° покрытие ядра объекта и прилегающей территории
parameters_ru.Синхронизация данных: Передача HD-видео в реальном времени через 5G в центр управления

detail_html_ru:
Детали обеспечения безопасности мероприятий

При огромном скоплении людей решение делает упор на скорость развертывания и высокую эффективность перехвата. Временные бесполетные зоны создаются переносными устройствами в сочетании со скоростными рамками досмотра.

  • Интеграция видеонаблюдения, защиты от БПЛА и досмотра
  • Эффективный перехват зажигалок, пороха, наркотиков и др.
  • Круглосуточный панорамный мониторинг всей территории объекта
